sloka: ते निसृष्टा महावेगाः शराः सर्पविषोपमाः।सम्प्राप्य लक्ष्मणं पेतुः श्वसन्त इव पन्नगाः ।। ६.८८.१८ ।।
transliteration: te nisṛṣṭā mahāvegāḥ śarāḥ sarpaviṣopamāḥ।samprāpya lakṣmaṇaṁ petuḥ śvasanta iva pannagāḥ ।। 6.88.18 ।।

translations.english: The shafts like deadly poisonous serpents reached Lakshmana at great speed hissing and fell on Lakshmana.
